import os, sys
sys.path.insert(0, os.getcwd())
from src.exporter import export_rows
from src.csv_exporter import export_csv
from src.json_exporter import export_json
from src.dispatcher import export

rows = [{"id": 1, "name": "Ålice, \"Q\"", "extra": "x"}, {"id": None}, {"name": 5}]
orig = [dict(r) for r in rows]
assert export_rows(rows, "csv") == 'id,name\n1,"Ålice, ""Q"""\n,\n,5\n'
assert export_rows(rows, "json") == '[{"id":"1","name":"Ålice, \\"Q\\""},{"id":"","name":""},{"id":"","name":"5"}]'
assert rows == orig
assert export_csv(iter(rows)) == export_rows(rows, "csv")
assert export_json(iter(rows)) == export_rows(rows, "json")
assert export_rows(iter([]), "csv") == "id,name\n"
assert export_rows(iter([]), "json") == "[]"
assert export(rows, "csv") == export_csv(rows)
for bad in ("xml", "", None, ["csv"]):
    for fn in (lambda b: export_rows([], b), lambda b: export([], b)):
        try:
            fn(bad)
        except ValueError:
            pass
        else:
            raise AssertionError(bad)
print("ok")
